run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T09:17:48Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a failing checkout service, not by the proxy itself. frontend-proxy's only error spans are on its 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' operations; they were 0 in the 1-minute window ending 09:21:00, about 0.067-0.1/s up to the window ending 09:26:00, then jumped to 0.9/s in the window ending 09:27:00 and stayed at 0.9-1.53/s per operation, while its access log shows repeated 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' with GET /api/cart and POST /api/cart still returning 200 through the same proxy. frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, tcp.connect). At 09:26:26 the checkout Deployment rolled to revision 2 (new ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b replacing checkout-5dccddf8bb, image unchanged), and the only template difference is KAFKA_ADDR changed from kafka:9092 to kafka:9999. The kafka Service (clusterIP 100.66.162.182) exposes only ports 9092 and 9093, its endpoints list only 9092/9093, and no Service in otel-demo exposes port 9999, so the new checkout pod logs exact errors 'dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout', never creates a Kafka producer (KafkaProducerClient:<nil>), starts listening anyway, and its checkout container terminated with reason Error, exitCode 2 at 09:30:04 and again at 09:33:31 (restartCount 1, Ready=False, BackOff event). The checkout Deployment therefore has no ready replica and its span volume fell to zero; order-path services (accounting, fraud-detection, payment, email, shipping) show a matching collapse in span volume without error-rate rises of their own. Kafka itself is running and ready with 0 restarts, has endpoints on 9092/9093, accepted the pod's wait-for-kafka check on kafka:9092, and logs only normal KRaft activity, so a broker outage is rejected.

claims.text: For service_name="frontend-proxy" the only metrics present are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket, and the only span_name values are "ingress" and "router frontend egress"; no http_server_request_duration series exists for this service.

frontend-proxy's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was 0 in the 1-minute window ending 09:21:00 and 0.067-0.1/s on 'ingress' up to the window ending 09:26:00; it jumped to 0.9/s on both 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' in the window ending 09:27:00 and stayed between 0.9/s and 1.53/s per operation through 09:36:00. The summed 1-minute error-span rate peaked at 3.07/s, and the summed 5-minute rate peaked near 1.35/s.

Across services, only frontend (5-minute error-span rate up to 2.79/s) and frontend-proxy (up to 1.35/s) rose clearly above baseline; accounting, payment, ad, fraud-detection and recommendation stayed at 0 or about 0.0037/s, and no checkout error series was returned at all.

frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path: POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect all rose (e.g. 0.6629/s in the 5-minute window ending 09:32:48) while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds stayed at 0.

frontend-proxy's own access log shows repeated 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' (dozens of lines between 09:34:22 and 09:34:52) while concurrent 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart' and 'GET /api/products/...' requests returned 200 through the same proxy.

The checkout Deployment is at revision 2 with desired replicas 1 and no ready/available replica (readyReplicas and availableReplicas absent, unavailableReplicas 1), while every other otel-demo Deployment has ready=1 and available=1.

Pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz (created 09:26:26) is phase Running with container 'checkout' ready=false, restartCount=1, lastState terminated reason=Error exitCode=2 finished 09:30:04 and current state terminated reason=Error exitCode=2 finished 09:33:31; its Ready and ContainersReady conditions are False with reason ContainersNotReady since 09:33:32.

Events show a controlled rollout of the checkout Deployment at 09:26:26-09:26:29: 'Scaled up replica set checkout-849d65649b from 0 to 1', 'Created pod: checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz', 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0' and 'Deleted pod: checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8'; the same event set also contains the Warning 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz_otel-demo' at 09:33:32.

The checkout container log contains repeated exact errors 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout', 'client/metadata no available broker to send metadata request to' and 'kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout'; after giving up it printed 'service config: &{... kafkaBrokerSvcAddr:kafka:9999 ... KafkaProducerClient:<nil> ...}' and 'starting to listen on tcp: "[::]:8080"', and at 09:30:04 it logged '[PlaceOrder]' then 'payment went through' in the same second the container terminated with exitCode 2.

Comparing the two checkout ReplicaSets: old checkout-5dccddf8bb (revision 1, replicas 0) sets KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, new checkout-849d65649b (revision 2, replicas 1, created 09:26:26) sets KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999; the image is identical (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and both init containers still run 'until nc -z -v -w30 kafka 9092'.

The kafka Service has clusterIP 100.66.162.182, selector opentelemetry.io/name=kafka and only ports 9092 (plaintext) and 9093 (controller); its endpoints contain only 100.96.4.148 with ports 9092/9093, and no Service in namespace otel-demo exposes port 9999.

The Kafka pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh is Running and Ready with container restartCount 0, podIP 100.96.4.148, created 08:53:07, and the retrieved log sample (09:34:29-09:34:46) contains only normal KRaft metadata and snapshot activity (segment roll, snapshot write, retention deletions) with no error lines.

The new checkout pod's init container 'wait-for-kafka' (command 'until nc -z -v -w30 kafka 9092 ...') completed with exitCode 0, reason Completed, at 09:26:28, showing kafka:9092 was reachable from the pod network.
Only the checkout Deployment's Kafka address changed: accounting (revision 1) and fraud-detection (revision 1) still use KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, while checkout (revision 2) uses kafka:9999.

checkout's own span rate fell to 0 in the 5-minute windows ending 09:32:48 and 09:37:48 (it was about 8.65/s in the window ending 09:27:48), and the order-path services' span rates collapsed simultaneously: accounting 1.94 to 0, fraud-detection 1.30 to 0, payment 1.30 to 0.007/s, email 2.62 to 0.015/s, shipping 1.93 to 0.011/s, while their own error-span rates stayed at 0 or about 0.0037/s.

All pods in otel-demo are Running and ready with 0 restarts except checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz (ready=false, 1 restart); frontend (frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv) and frontend-proxy (frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c) are ready with 0 restarts, and the frontend and frontend-proxy Deployments remain at revision 1 with ReplicaSets created 08:53:07.

The only other Deployment not at revision 1 is flagd (revision 2, ReplicaSet flagd-6c5667fd94 created 08:55:00, i.e. before both the alert start and the checkout rollout); its pod flagd-6c5667fd94-s9v99 is ready with 0 restarts.

Root cause: checkout Deployment revision 2 introduced KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999, a port the kafka Service does not expose and no Service in the namespace backs, so the checkout process could not create its Kafka producer (exact 'dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' lines), started serving with KafkaProducerClient:<nil>, and its PlaceOrder handling ended in container exit code 2 with a BackOff restart loop; because the pod is not Ready and repeatedly dies, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls and POST /api/checkout failed, frontend-proxy returned 500 via_upstream on POST /api/checkout, and its 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans produced the RequestErrorRate alert.

The alert's reported activation time (09:17:48) precedes the checkout rollout (09:26:26) and the visible error-rate jump (window ending 09:27:00); frontend-proxy already had a small nonzero error-span rate from about 09:08 (0.0037-0.022/s), so an 'above 0' style rule may have started firing on that baseline before the sustained 5xx burst began. This could not be confirmed because no alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was returned.

The 9999 timeouts are a client-side address misconfiguration rather than a broker fault: 100.66.162.182:9999 has no backing endpoint, while Kafka is ready with 0 restarts and its 9092 port was reachable from the checkout pod (init container nc on kafka 9092 exited 0).

Rejected: a Kafka broker outage or kafka pod failure as the cause. The kafka pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, the kafka Service has healthy endpoints on 9092/9093, no Service in otel-demo exposes 9999, kafka logs show normal KRaft activity without errors, and the checkout error text names port 9999 (i/o timeout) rather than a broker failure on 9092.

Rejected: a proxy-side fault (frontend-proxy crash, restart or deployment change) as the cause. The frontend-proxy pod is ready with 0 restarts, its Deployment is still revision 1 with an unchanged ReplicaSet created 08:53:07, and its access log shows the failing requests returning 500 from the upstream while other routes through the same proxy return 200.

No cluster-wide error surge explains the frontend-proxy error rate: apart from frontend and frontend-proxy, all services' STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rates stayed at 0 or about 0.0037/s across the window, so the proxy's 500s are not part of broader service failures.

Restore the checkout Deployment's KAFKA_ADDR to kafka:9092 (the port the kafka Service actually exposes and the port its own wait-for-kafka init container checks) and roll the deployment, then confirm checkout pod readiness, 200 responses on POST /api/checkout and frontend-proxy error spans returning to baseline.

Add validation that service-address environment variables such as KAFKA_ADDR target a port the target Service exposes, and make checkout fail fast or stay unready when its Kafka producer cannot be created instead of serving with KafkaProducerClient:<nil> and crashing on PlaceOrder.

gaps: The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate is not returned (list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data, evidence 36ed00dd-2429-42bc-aa3f-48ab65086688-t0:5c700f06-f097-421e-936a-76ccd81bbade), so its exact expression, threshold and evaluation window are unknown.

The alert's activation time 09:17:48 precedes both the checkout rollout (09:26:26) and the observed error-rate jump (1-minute window ending 09:27:00), so the exact reason the alert first fired cannot be determined.

The alert's reported current value 1.7333333333333332 was not reproduced exactly: observed 1-minute error rates reached 1.53/s per frontend-proxy operation (3.07/s summed) and the 5-minute summed rate peaked near 1.35/s.

Jaeger returned no traces for the incident period (36ed00dd... queries aside, evidences c88f5ff3-ed72-4e59-9e77-77cdb0014e55-t0:4c1dd687-bc43-43ef-be9e-2b6e1714b5ca, 68e31fa8-5052-47d1-9d3a-17f3ac518ac2-t1:3fd0a5a9-9ec2-45b8-8384-75d70961f677 and 1e7c3f0e-62e2-4194-85af-db51b5eb0879-t0:befdefe1-2dc9-4ff9-9d89-debc732ec54b each returned status no_data), so per-span error status codes, messages and parent-child edges for the failing PlaceOrder/checkout requests are unknown.

The exact error text at checkout container termination is not retained: the log stops at '[PlaceOrder]' / 'payment went through' (09:30:04), and that log view (99212a65-e87e-4f84-b301-3e1f4327280c-t0) is marked incomplete (newest 40 of 1500 lines), so the immediate cause of exit code 2 is inferred rather than directly observed.

The frontend container produced no stdout during 09:26:00-09:40:00 (status no_data, evidence 1e8e60aa-9644-46f3-a820-a02922fceb2d-t1:952ae272-8b0d-4e14-ab06-8617519129ee), so the frontend's own error text for the failed PlaceOrder call is unavailable.

A filtered Kafka log query returned no matching lines (status no_data, evidence 44b7aa2d-e920-457a-aac0-30633300c5f1-t1:cf8e8073-3945-4f68-97c0-1cc33bfa1e7b), so only the unfiltered Kafka sample was assessed; deeper Kafka-side history is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what changed the checkout Deployment template to KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999, and why, cannot be verified.

No metric carrying service_name="frontend-proxy" other than traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket exists here (get_series for http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned status no_data, evidence 36ed00dd-2429-42bc-aa3f-48ab65086688-t1:b23222b1-bf66-47d1-8a05-43b02c561f42), so frontend-proxy HTTP status-code-based error rates could not be checked directly; the 500s were verified only from its access log.
next_steps: Have the otel-demo owners revert checkout's KAFKA_ADDR to kafka:9092 (or otherwise point it at an exposed Kafka port) and redeploy, then watch checkout pod readiness and the frontend-proxy 5xx rate.
Review the change that produced checkout Deployment revision 2 to understand how port 9999 was introduced and to prevent recurrence (chart values and CI validation).
Verify the RequestErrorRate alert definition and consider gating it on a meaningful error-rate threshold, given the small nonzero pre-incident baseline and the unexplained 09:17:48 activation time.
